name: Interpolation Degree of the SCVC/Interpolation Reverse Separation Class
proof: The evaluation matrix of $1,x_1,x_2,x_3,z$ on the four concepts has rank three, so degree one cannot interpolate every function. Including degree-two monomials has rank four, so degree two does suffice. This exact rank calculation is checked by $\texttt{sync/verify\_interpolation\_conjecture.py}$.
